In the modern city, Su Xing transmigrates over.
He originally wanted to start a business and take off, but unexpectedly awakened the Sword Saint System. With the idea of not letting the system go to waste, Su Xing became a Swordsmanship coach.
He thought his days would pass peacefully like this, until he discovered that this world actually had Extraordinary powers, and his younger brother was a uniquely talented Sequencer.
An unprecedented door to the Extraordinary world opened before him from then on.
Sequencers, the Spiritual Sect, Him/It, Secret Realms, Sequence Beasts—one troublesome matter after another followed.
Su Yu said worriedly: “Big brother, it's okay if you don't have the talent to become a Sequencer. I will definitely work hard to become strong and protect you!”
Su Xing smiled faintly: “There's no need for that. I just need to add points to my system.”
Slash—One strike to split the heavens.
Thrust—Locking onto causality.
Breathing Rhythm—The Way of the Sword Saint.
system-awakened-i-became-the-mafia-kings:
Nova never expected to open her eyes in a world that belonged to the past—much less inside the body of a girl named Anah.
Anah was known as a fool. Since birth, she had barely spoken, rarely reacted, and carried an empty expression that made people wonder if she even had a soul.
Her family treated her like a useless burden.
Then, Abigail—her own sister—sold Anah to an underground bar.
Everyone thought that was where Anah’s insignificant life would end.
They were wrong.
Nova’s soul awakened inside Anah’s body.
A soul from the future, now trapped in the past with an advanced System, mysterious abilities, and no memory of who she truly was.
After discovering how Anah was betrayed and sold by the very people who should have protected her, Nova decides that if the world wants to treat her like a monster, then she will gladly become one.
With an extraordinary System capable of uncovering secrets, manipulating technology, tracking enemies, and revealing information no ordinary person could obtain, Nova begins tearing apart everyone who stands in her way.
And then come the men who become hopelessly obsessed with her, entirely blind to her dark side.
the-longest-day-in-changan:
Chang’an, Jan. 14th of lunar month, Tianbao Year 3 (744AD), Tang Dynasty.
For residents of Imperial City, what awaits them when the city enjoys its dazzling brilliance and joy of the Lantern Festival is an unexpected catastrophe that’ll destroy all. Tujue (a nationality in the north of ancient China), Wolfpack, kidnapping, assassination, rampant flames that scorch all…start the gear for the doom of and the Longest Day in Chang’an.
And the only hope lies in a one-eyed convict sentenced to death and the fleeting Twelve Hours…Will Chang’an, the city of prosperity, survive the longest day ever or will it burn…
the-most-powerful-wealth-system:
After all his family members passed away, Riki only had his girlfriend whom he could trust. He gave everything to his girlfriend, Hannah.
However, that trust was shattered that night when Riki saw Hannah being hugged by someone he hated deeply, Anton.
“Stop bothering me, Riki! We're already broken up; I can't keep dating a poor loser like you! You might be a little more handsome, but are you even close to Anton? No! He can give me a luxurious apartment, get me the designer items I’ve always dreamed of! While you don’t even try at all!”
“A poor corrupt’s son like you doesn’t deserve the prettiest girl on campus like Hannah; you’ll only tarnish her reputation.”
There was no hope, it was pitiful. Riki was beaten by Anton’s thugs.
In that narrow, smelly alley, Riki might have to give up his life there.
His life was truly pitiful.
In the end, he had to die miserably, just like his family. Maybe Riki would soon meet them after this.
However, suddenly an odd screen appeared before him.…
weird-rules-rumor-at-the-beginning-he-in:
This is a world that has been captured by the rules of horror.
The chosen ones become players and enter mysterious dungeons.
In the dungeons, players receive special skills that help them in the game.
Bai Liang was also chosen, but his skill is different from the others.
【Stubbornness: When you die, you can stubbornly claim that you are not dead and immediately resurrect.】
【Lawless Outlaw: You can disobey the rules, and others will not be able to do anything to you.】
【Everything for Me: When a mission fails, one player is randomly selected to die in your place. After completing the mission, you receive half of the reward of all survivors.】
【Chronograph: After entering the dungeon, time slows down for everyone, and you can move secretly.】
【Switch to “Idle” Mode: Activate idle mode, and all your tasks are transferred to other players.】
【Quick End: The mission ends automatically, the rest of the players are eliminated.】
will-of-a-prince: This story follows a young man named Prince Jacob. His father raised him to believe that being weak was the gravest sin one could commit and that those who are weak should be viewed as less than human. However, after going through many troubles and challenges, Jacob finds himself questioning his father's legacy. Eventually, Jacob dares to carve his own path into the heavens to redeem himself from those who he wronged and strive for a perfect future of peace.
wizards-begin-liver-experience-with-knig:
Travel across different worlds and become a fallen aristocratic lord.
With the help of the proficiency panel, you can start your liver experience with the ancestral knight breathing method, follow the wizard’s footsteps step by step, and embark on a bizarre and mysterious journey.
world-of-beasts-i-can-see-their-hidden-s:
“Locke transmigrated into an era where everyone had Battle Beasts. Daemons were rampant and humans were forced to build walls around their dwellings while depending on Beastmasters to keep those monsters at bay.
It was time for academies to open their enrollments and Locke only had a small snake that everyone claimed was useless!
“”A snake? Isn’t this just a normal snake? What a useless Battle Beast.””
“”What potential can a snake have? Even if it evolves into a two-headed snake that’s still only Level 1 strength. You might as well continue living like any other normal folk.””
“”Who are you kidding? What makes you think you have what it takes to enter a Beastmaster University?””
Locke stayed calm as countless classmates and teachers mocked and made fun of him while he turned to his System’s interface. “”All Beasts Hidden Evolution Paths!””
From a Two-headed snake to a Fire-and-Ice Two-headed snake... Then to a Demonic Shadow Snake... a Bright Serpent... Before finally, evolving into Medusa...”
worlds-end-my-keyword-is-one-more-than-o:
In a world where survival depends on victory in an alien battlefield, warriors are assigned a crucial keyword that determines their fate.
With attributes that rapidly grow when aligned with their keyword, they gain superhuman abilities.
But if their persona collapses, they weaken. In this apocalyptic-like world, acting skills are paramount.
Acting is sustenance, glory, privilege, and life. Join the battle and discover the true meaning of bravery, cunning, righteousness, and more.
